title: A SECOND NEGATIVE CONFIRMS THE COUNTEREXAMPLE
semantic_thesis: The third exact-spec receipt does not erase the earlier positive run and does not erase the historical negative. Instead, it adds a second conforming negative receipt. Under the frozen capability-preservation rule, this strengthens the conclusion that Q8_0 cannot currently be promoted as an identity-preserving replacement: the observed failure is not merely a single isolated negative run. The same model digest under the same experimental specification produced both positive and negative receipts, while the fresh negative reproduces the earlier 20/24 outcome.

ru: Второй отрицательный receipt не стирает положительный — он показывает, что положительный прогон не был достаточным основанием для promotion.
Повторение 20/24 на том же exact-spec ослабляет гипотезу о единичном выбросе.
Один успешный прогон и два неуспешных не голосуют друг против друга: promotion требует отсутствия допустимого контрпримера, а не большинства.
FP16 остаётся authoritative reference в проверенном critical scope.
Следующий научно полезный вопрос — изолировать источник межзапусковой и внутри-модельной недетерминированности, не меняя CriticalFrozenSet задним числом.
en: A second negative receipt does not erase the positive receipt; it shows that the positive run was insufficient for promotion.
Repeating 20/24 under the same exact specification weakens the single-outlier hypothesis.
One successful run and two failed runs do not vote against each other: promotion requires the absence of an admissible counterexample, not a majority.
FP16 remains the authoritative reference in the tested critical scope.
The next scientifically useful question is to isolate the source of cross-run and within-model nondeterminism without changing the CriticalFrozenSet retroactively.

claim_ceiling: This semantic artifact records a model-evaluation finding for one frozen eight-sample critical set and one exact experimental-spec lineage. It does not establish universal model behavior, general quantization losslessness, official benchmark accuracy, AGI, consciousness, or independent external replication.
